patch_description:
The previous iteration attempted to increase expressivity by adding redundant RX rotations, which led to a bloated parameter count (50) and reduced generalization (generalization gap increased to 0.02, accuracy dropped to 0.88).

My proposed design returns to the lean, high-performing 26-parameter architecture that achieved 0.93 test accuracy. I have refined the entanglement layer to be slightly more symmetric and efficient, ensuring we maximize the information flow across all 8 qubits while keeping the trainable parameter count low (26 parameters total). By removing redundant parameters and focusing on the core entanglement strategy that previously yielded the best results, this design aims to recover and improve upon the 0.56 combined score.
